label: Change request summary
description: Totals, merged/open/closed counts, comments per change request, unique authors and labels, and time to first comment.
evidence: Change request records with author, labels, comments, and created/merged/closed timestamps from the git provider.
formula: Counts records in the selected window, totals comments and unique authors/labels, then derives first/last change request by created date, top comment themes from n-grams, most-commented change requests, top commenter, and average hours to the first comment.
notation: counts = |{cr ∈ CR}|; comments/CR = Σ comments ÷ |CR|; t_first = mean(t_first_comment − t_created)

label: Change request metrics
description: Aggregate change request metrics for the selected window: open days, comments, lead time, and label and comment summaries.
evidence: Change request records with author, labels, comments, and created/merged/closed timestamps.
formula: Aggregates open days (creation to merge/close, or now when still open), comments per change request, and lead time with the selected statistical method; includes label and comment summaries.
notation: open_days = days((merged_at ∨ closed_at ∨ now) − created_at); comments = Σ comments; lead_time = open_days

label: Change request throughput
description: Change requests opened and closed per day, week, or month.
evidence: Change request records with created, merged, and closed timestamps.
formula: Counts change requests opened by created date and closed by merge/close date per day, week, or month, and emits one series row per period and kind.
notation: opened(p) = |{cr: created_at ∈ p}|; closed(p) = |{cr: merged_at ∨ closed_at ∈ p}|

label: Change request volume by author
description: Change request count grouped by author.
evidence: Change request records and their author login.
formula: Groups change requests by author, counts each group, and returns the top N authors sorted by count.

label: Review time
description: Days from change request creation to review, per author, using the selected statistical method.
evidence: Merged or closed change requests with created and merged/closed timestamps, grouped by author.
formula: Computes days from creation to merge/close per change request, groups the samples by author, and applies the selected method (average/median/p75/p90/p95/min/max).

label: Open time
description: Days a change request stays open, grouped by day, week, or month, using the selected statistical method.
evidence: Change request records with created and merged/closed timestamps.
formula: Computes days open per change request (to merge/close, or now when still open), groups samples by day/week/month, and applies the selected statistical method.
notation: open_days = ((merged_at ∨ closed_at ∨ now) − created_at) ÷ 86 400 000; value(period) = method(open_days)

label: Comments per change request
description: Number of comments per change request, using the selected statistical method and optional aggregation period.
evidence: Change request records and their total comment counts.
formula: Collects comments per change request, optionally groups the samples by period, and applies the selected statistical method to the distribution.

label: Comments by reviewer
description: Comment volume grouped by reviewer.
evidence: Comments attached to change requests with the commenter login.
formula: Counts comments per commenter, sorts descending, and returns the top N reviewers.

label: Time to first comment
description: Hours from change request creation to its first comment, per author.
evidence: Change requests with comments and timestamps for creation and the first comment.
formula: Computes hours from creation to the earliest comment, groups samples by change request author, and applies the selected statistical method.

label: Change requests by week
description: Change request metrics grouped by week: totals, merged/closed/open counts, comments, open days, and lead time.
evidence: Merged change requests with created/merged timestamps and comments.
formula: Groups merged change requests by timezone-aware week and computes totals, merged/closed/open counts, open days, comments, and lead time per week.
notation: week = iso_week(merged_at); value = {count, merged, closed, open, open_days, comments, lead_time}

label: Change requests by month
description: Change request metrics grouped by month: totals, merged/closed/open counts, comments, open days, and lead time.
evidence: Change requests with created/merged timestamps and comments.
formula: Groups change requests by timezone-aware calendar month and computes totals, merged/closed/open counts, open days, comments, and lead time per month.
notation: month = calendar_month(created_at); value = {count, merged, closed, open, open_days, comments, lead_time}

label: Change request labels
description: Change request count per label. Embedded in the change request summary.
evidence: Change request labels attached to each change request.
formula: Counts change requests per distinct label (case-insensitive), adds average open days per label, and sorts by count.

label: Change request bottleneck evaluation
description: Bottleneck signals covering review time, reviewer workload, open time, throughput, first comment, and comment health.
evidence: Aggregated change request metrics, review-time distributions, comment counts, and per-author comment volume.
formula: Runs six threshold-based signal detectors (review_time, reviewer_workload, open_time, throughput, first_comment, comment_health) and returns each signal with severity, metrics, and description.
notation: signals = {review_time, reviewer_workload, open_time, throughput, first_comment, comment_health}

label: Pipeline summary
description: Run totals by conclusion, in-progress and queued counts, success rate, and aggregate duration.
evidence: Pipeline runs with status, conclusion, attempt metadata, and job start/completion timestamps.
formula: Counts runs by conclusion plus in-progress/queued, computes success rate as successful divided by completed times 100, and aggregates run duration (max job completion minus min job start) with the selected method.
notation: success_rate = successful ÷ completed × 100; duration = max(job.completed_at) − min(job.started_at); value = method(duration)

label: Runs by status
description: Pipeline run count grouped by conclusion.
evidence: Pipeline runs and their conclusion values.
formula: Groups runs by conclusion and counts each group.

label: Jobs by status
description: Pipeline job count grouped by status.
evidence: Pipeline jobs and their conclusion/status values.
formula: Groups jobs by conclusion (falling back to status) and counts each group.

label: Run duration
description: Pipeline run duration with minimum, maximum, and selected statistical aggregation.
evidence: Pipeline runs and their job start/completion timestamps, grouped by workflow.
formula: Computes each run duration as max job completion minus min job start, groups samples by workflow, and returns the minimum, maximum, and selected aggregation.
notation: duration(run) = max(job.completed_at) − min(job.started_at); value(workflow) = method(duration); min/max = min(duration)/max(duration)

label: Runs over time
description: Pipeline run count per period and workflow.
evidence: Pipeline runs with completion/creation timestamps and workflow path.
formula: Groups runs by day and workflow and counts them per period.
notation: runs(day, workflow) = |{run: date(run) = day ∧ run.path = workflow}|

label: Job summary
description: Per-job run counts, success and failure rates, rerun counts, and duration statistics.
evidence: Pipeline jobs with conclusion, run attempt, and start/completion timestamps.
formula: Groups jobs by workflow and normalized job name, counts runs and successes/failures, sums reruns as attempt minus one, applies the selected duration aggregation, and derives success/failure rates.
notation: success_rate = success ÷ total × 100; failure_rate = failure ÷ total × 100; reruns = Σ max(run_attempt − 1, 0); value = method(job_duration)

label: Job execution time
description: Pipeline job execution duration using the selected statistical method.
evidence: Pipeline jobs with start and completion timestamps.
formula: Computes each job duration in minutes, groups samples by normalized job name, and applies the selected statistical method.

label: Job time by day
description: Daily pipeline job execution duration series.
evidence: Pipeline jobs with start/completion timestamps and the run completion/creation date.
formula: Computes job durations in minutes, groups samples by run day, and applies the selected statistical method per day.

label: Job step execution time
description: Pipeline job step duration using the selected statistical method.
evidence: Pipeline job steps with name and start/completion timestamps.
formula: Computes each step duration in minutes, groups samples by step name, and applies the selected statistical method.

label: Job step time by day
description: Daily pipeline job step duration series.
evidence: Pipeline job steps with name and start/completion timestamps, plus the run date.
formula: Computes step durations in minutes, groups samples by run day and step name, and applies the selected statistical method per group.

label: Reruns by day
description: Daily pipeline job rerun count.
evidence: Pipeline runs with attempt number and completion/creation date.
formula: Computes reruns per run as max(attempt minus 1, 0) and sums reruns per day.

label: Job duration by workflow
description: Pipeline job duration grouped by workflow.
evidence: Pipeline jobs with workflow path and start/completion timestamps.
formula: Computes job durations in minutes and returns the arithmetic mean per job, grouped by workflow.

label: Deployment frequency
description: DORA deployment frequency measured per day, week, and month.
evidence: Successful pipeline runs and successful jobs matching each configured deployment target (pipeline plus job).
formula: Counts successful target jobs per day/week/month, zero-fills missing intervals, and returns the latest period count per target.
notation: frequency(p, target) = |{job: target ∧ job.conclusion = success ∧ completed_at ∈ p}|

label: Lead time for changes
description: DORA lead time for changes, in minutes.
evidence: Pipeline dashboard summary for the selected window and deployment target.
formula: Returns the dashboard summary aggregate value in minutes (the same run-duration aggregation used by the pipeline dashboard).

label: Pipeline bottleneck evaluation
description: Bottleneck signals covering job duration, stability, reruns, slowest workflow, and job overview.
evidence: Pipeline dashboard data: job durations, job summaries, reruns, workflows, and job counts.
formula: Runs five signal detectors (duration_top_job, stability_worst_job, rerun_analysis, slowest_workflow, job_overview) and returns each signal with severity, metrics, and description.

label: Big O complexity
description: Per-file algorithmic complexity classification, score, and whether the file needs performance attention.
evidence: Source files in the configured repository, scanned line by line for loops, sort calls, binary searches, and iteration helpers.
formula: Classifies the highest-weight signal per file as O(1) through O(n^3+), scores it as min(100, topWeight times 12 plus signalCount times 2), and flags needsHelp when the score is 60 or more.
notation: classification = argmax(weight[signal]); score = min(100, weight[top] × 12 + |signals| × 2); needs_help = score ≥ 60

label: Code summary
description: Code overview with developer pairing insights.
evidence: Git commits with author, co-authors, changed files, and timestamps.
formula: Uses the pairing index (paired commits divided by analyzed commits times 100) as the summary core and exposes paired commit counts and top pairs.

label: Code churn
description: Commits, lines added, lines deleted, and total churn over time.
evidence: Git commits in the selected window with lines added and deleted.
formula: Aggregates additions, deletions, commit counts, and total churn (added plus deleted) per day; the series projects one churn type.
notation: churn(day) = Σ added(day) + Σ deleted(day); value = {added, deleted, commits, churn}

label: Churn by author
description: Lines added, lines deleted, and commit count per author.
evidence: Git commits with author and line-level churn.
formula: Groups additions, deletions, and commit counts by author.
notation: churn(author) = {Σ added, Σ deleted, Σ commits}

label: File coupling
description: Coupling degree and average revisions between file pairs.
evidence: CodeMaat file-coupling output: pairs of files that change in the same commits.
formula: Returns the coupling degree (shared revisions divided by revisions of the entity) and average revisions per pair, optionally filtered by minimum coupling and path patterns.

label: Layered coupling
description: Coupling between architectural layers.
evidence: CodeMaat layered-coupling output aggregated by file path group.
formula: Returns coupling degree and average revisions between architectural layers derived from path groups.

label: Entity churn
description: Lines added, lines deleted, and commit count per entity.
evidence: CodeMaat entity-churn output with per-file added/deleted lines and commit counts.
formula: Returns added, deleted, and commit totals per entity, with optional path filters and top-N.
notation: churn(entity) = {Σ added, Σ deleted, Σ commits}

label: Entity effort
description: Revision count per entity, used as an effort proxy.
evidence: CodeMaat entity-effort output with revision counts per file.
formula: Returns total revisions per entity as the effort proxy, with optional path filters and top-N.

label: Entity ownership
description: Lines added and deleted per author for each entity.
evidence: CodeMaat entity-ownership output with author, file, additions, and deletions.
formula: Returns lines added and deleted per author per entity, with optional author/path filters and top-N.

label: Pairing index
description: Percentage of commits with co-authors, paired commit count, and the most frequent pairs.
evidence: Git commits with author, co-authors, changed files, and timestamps.
formula: Computes (commits with co-authors divided by total analyzed commits) times 100, plus the paired commit count and top author pairs.

label: CRAP score
description: Change risk anti-pattern score derived from complexity and coverage per file.
evidence: Per-file cyclomatic complexity and test coverage from SonarQube component data.
formula: CRAP equals complexity squared times (1 minus coverage divided by 100) cubed, plus complexity, rounded to one decimal.

label: Code churn history
description: Timestamped code churn series.
evidence: Timestamped CodeMaat churn entries.
formula: Returns the stored churn series (date, added, deleted, commits) in chronological order.

label: File coupling history
description: Timestamped file coupling series.
evidence: Timestamped CodeMaat file-coupling entries.
formula: Returns the stored coupling series with degree and average revisions per snapshot.

label: Layered coupling history
description: Timestamped layered coupling series.
evidence: Timestamped CodeMaat layered-coupling entries.
formula: Returns the stored layered-coupling series per snapshot.

label: Entity churn history
description: Timestamped entity churn series.
evidence: Timestamped CodeMaat entity-churn entries.
formula: Returns the stored per-entity added/deleted/commit series.

label: Entity effort history
description: Timestamped entity effort series.
evidence: Timestamped CodeMaat entity-effort entries.
formula: Returns the stored per-entity revision series.

label: Entity ownership history
description: Timestamped entity ownership series.
evidence: Timestamped CodeMaat entity-ownership entries.
formula: Returns the stored per-author and per-entity added/deleted series.

label: Code evaluation
description: Code signals covering churn hotspots, churn trend, coupling, ownership concentration, complexity, Big O, and pairing.
evidence: Code dashboard data: entity churn, daily churn, coupling, ownership, CRAP, Big O, and pairing.
formula: Runs ten threshold-based signal detectors (churn_hotspot, churn_trend, coupling_top, coupling_burst, ownership_concentration, ownership_unknown, complexity_hotspot, complexity_big_o, pairing_index, pairing_concentration) and returns severity, metrics, and description.
notation: signals = {churn_hotspot, churn_trend, coupling_top, coupling_burst, ownership_concentration, ownership_unknown, complexity_hotspot, complexity_big_o, pairing_index, pairing_concentration}

label: Coverage
description: Line coverage measured by SonarQube. Embedded in the change request summary.
evidence: SonarQube coverage measure for the project.
formula: Returns the stored line-coverage percentage.

label: Maintainability rating
description: SonarQube maintainability rating (sqale_rating).
evidence: SonarQube sqale_rating measure.
formula: Returns the 1-to-5 maintainability rating.

label: Reliability rating
description: SonarQube reliability rating.
evidence: SonarQube reliability_rating measure.
formula: Returns the 1-to-5 reliability rating consumed by the quality evaluation.

label: Security rating
description: SonarQube security rating.
evidence: SonarQube security_rating measure.
formula: Returns the 1-to-5 security rating consumed by the quality evaluation.

label: Complexity
description: Total cyclomatic complexity measured by SonarQube.
evidence: SonarQube complexity measure.
formula: Returns the total cyclomatic complexity.

label: Cognitive complexity
description: Per-component cognitive complexity from the SonarQube component tree.
evidence: SonarQube component tree with cognitive_complexity measures per component.
formula: Returns the per-component cognitive-complexity rows from the latest component tree.

label: Duplication density
description: Percentage of duplicated lines measured by SonarQube.
evidence: SonarQube duplicated_lines_density measure.
formula: Returns the duplicated-lines percentage.

label: Non-commenting lines of code
description: Non-commenting lines of code measured by SonarQube.
evidence: SonarQube ncloc measure.
formula: Returns non-commenting lines of code.

label: Code smells
description: Code smell count measured by SonarQube.
evidence: SonarQube code_smells measure.
formula: Returns the code-smell count.

label: Bugs
description: Bug count measured by SonarQube.
evidence: SonarQube bugs measure.
formula: Returns the bug count.

label: Component tree
description: Per-component SonarQube measures including complexity, size, rating, and coverage.
evidence: SonarQube component-tree response with per-component measures.
formula: Maps each component to its complexity, ncloc, rating, coverage, duplication, and cognitive-complexity fields.
notation: component = {complexity, ncloc, rating, coverage, duplication, cognitive_complexity}

label: Component tree history
description: Timestamped SonarQube component tree entries.
evidence: Stored SonarQube component-tree snapshots.
formula: Returns each timestamped component-tree entry in chronological order.

label: SonarQube measurements
description: Raw SonarQube measure set for the project.
evidence: Raw SonarQube measure set for the project.
formula: Returns the stored measures without aggregation.

label: Measurements history
description: Timestamped SonarQube measure entries.
evidence: Stored SonarQube measurement entries.
formula: Returns the stored time series per metric.

label: Quality evaluation
description: Quality signals covering reliability, security, maintainability, duplication, coverage, and complexity outliers.
evidence: SonarQube quality metrics and component tree.
formula: Runs seven threshold-based signal detectors (reliability_rating, security_rating, maintainability_rating, duplication_density, coverage_health, complexity_outlier, coverage_outlier) and returns severity, metrics, and description.
notation: signals = {reliability_rating, security_rating, maintainability_rating, duplication_density, coverage_health, complexity_outlier, coverage_outlier}

label: Architecture snapshot
description: Persisted architecture snapshot metadata.
evidence: Persisted architecture snapshots with id, timestamp, project, branch, commit count, and available views.
formula: Lists snapshot headers; each snapshot is generated from package.json discovery plus git commit history.
notation: snapshot = {id, generated_at, project, branch, commit_count, views}

label: Architecture summary
description: Container, edge, confidence, orphan, and hub summaries for a snapshot.
evidence: Latest architecture snapshot's selected C4 view with nodes and relationships.
formula: Counts containers, edges, orphan nodes, average edge confidence, most-connected node, and hub node.
notation: summary = {containers = |nodes|, edges = |edges|, avg_confidence = mean(confidence), orphans, most_connected = argmax(in_degree), hub = argmax(out_degree)}

label: Architecture view
description: C4 context, container, component, or code view with nodes and relationships.
evidence: Latest architecture snapshot's context, container, component, or code view.
formula: Returns the selected view's nodes and edges, filtered by include/ignore path patterns when provided.
notation: view = {nodes, edges} filtered by path patterns

label: Container count
description: Number of containers in the architecture snapshot.
evidence: Architecture snapshot nodes of kind container or component.
formula: Counts matching nodes; severity is warning at 12 and critical at 20.

label: Dependency concentration
description: Concentration of relationships around a small set of dependencies.
evidence: Architecture relationships with incoming edges per node.
formula: Computes the highest incoming-edge count divided by the average incoming edges per node; severity is warning at 1.5 and critical at 3.

label: Hub dependency
description: The architecture node with the most incoming dependencies.
evidence: Architecture relationships with outgoing edges per node.
formula: Computes the highest outgoing-edge count divided by the average outgoing edges per node; severity is warning at 1.5 and critical at 3.

label: Orphan nodes
description: Architecture nodes that have no relationships.
evidence: Architecture nodes and the source/target ids of all relationships.
formula: Counts nodes with no incident edge and divides by total nodes; severity is warning at 2 orphans and critical at 5.

label: Relationship confidence
description: Average confidence of detected architecture relationships.
evidence: Architecture relationships and their confidence scores.
formula: Averages edge confidence and counts edges below 0.5; severity is warning below 0.7 and critical below 0.5 average confidence.

label: Architecture evaluation
description: Architecture signals covering container count, dependency concentration, hub dependency, orphan nodes, and confidence.
evidence: Architecture snapshot view plus the summary signals.
formula: Runs container_count, dependency_concentration, hub_dependency, orphan_nodes, and confidence_health detectors and returns severity, metrics, and description.

label: Issue count
description: Total Jira issues for the selected window and status filter.
evidence: Jira issues matching the selected project, window, and status filter.
formula: Counts the matching issue records.

label: Issue records
description: Raw Jira issue records backing the issue count.
evidence: Jira issue records matching the selected filter.
formula: Returns the raw issue rows that back the count.

label: Deployment frequency
description: Successful deployments per selected period for each configured deployment target.
evidence: Successful deployment-target jobs (configured pipeline plus job) per day/week/month.
formula: Counts successful target jobs per period and returns the latest period count per target; missing intervals are zero-filled.
notation: frequency(p, target) = |{job: target ∧ success ∧ completed_at ∈ p}|

label: Lead time
description: Time from change creation to deployment.
evidence: Pipeline dashboard summary for the selected window and deployment target.
formula: Returns the summary aggregate value in minutes, using the same run-duration aggregation as the pipeline dashboard.

label: Pipeline duration
description: Average pipeline run duration.
evidence: Pipeline runs with job start/completion timestamps.
formula: Aggregates run duration (max job completion minus min job start) with the selected method and returns the value in minutes.

label: Failure rate
description: Percentage of failed pipeline runs.
evidence: Pipeline runs with conclusion values.
formula: Failure rate equals failed runs divided by total runs times 100, rounded to two decimals.

label: Complexity
description: Total complexity reported by SonarQube.
evidence: SonarQube complexity measure.
formula: Returns the total complexity value.

label: Duplication
description: Duplicated lines density reported by SonarQube.
evidence: SonarQube duplicated_lines_density measure.
formula: Returns the duplicated-lines percentage.

label: Coverage
description: Line coverage reported by SonarQube.
evidence: SonarQube coverage measure.
formula: Returns line coverage percentage.

label: Review time
description: Average time from change request creation to review.
evidence: Merged or closed change requests with created and merged/closed timestamps, grouped by author.
formula: Computes each author's average review days, then averages those author values into one score, rounded to two decimals.

label: Review participation
description: Number of unique reviewers participating in the window.
evidence: Comments on change requests with the commenter login.
formula: Counts unique commenters (reviewers) in the selected window.

label: Pair programming
description: Pairing index across analyzed commits.
evidence: Git commits with co-authors and changed files.
formula: Pairing index equals paired commits divided by total analyzed commits times 100.

label: Knowledge distribution
description: Share of touched lines not owned by the top contributor.
evidence: CodeMaat entity ownership with author, added, and deleted lines.
formula: 100 minus the top contributor's touched lines divided by total touched lines times 100, where touched equals added plus deleted.

label: Coupling
description: Average file coupling degree.
evidence: CodeMaat file-coupling pairs and their degree.
formula: Arithmetic mean of all coupling degrees, rounded to two decimals.

label: Ownership
description: Share of touched lines owned by the top contributor.
evidence: CodeMaat entity ownership with author, added, and deleted lines.
formula: Top contributor's touched lines divided by total touched lines times 100, rounded to two decimals.

label: Components
description: Number of components in the architecture component view.
evidence: Architecture component-view nodes.
formula: Counts nodes whose kind is component.
